channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: ‘Nina Roza’ Review: A Bulgarian Exile Returns to His Roots in This Insightful, Lyrically Crafted Drama of Art and Estrangement
item.description: The latest feature from Quebecois director Geneviève Dulude-de Celles ('The Colony') stars Galin Stoev as a curator searching for an 8-year-old artistic prodigy in his native Bulgaria.

item.title: Shia LaBeouf’s Mardi Gras Bar Crawl: “He’s Terrorizing the City”
item.description: The mercurial actor, allegedly sober for years, has been letting loose for nearly a week in New Orleans in the lead-up to Fat Tuesday.

item.title: L.A. Mayor Karen Bass Now Says Casey Wasserman Should “Step Down” From LA28 Amid Epstein Files Backlash
item.description: Her comments came after the L.A. Olympics Committee board publicly backed Wasserman, who announced the sale of his company last week.

item.title: Fiji Airways Is Latest Airline to Offer ‘On-Demand Dining’ Program In Flight
item.description: In addition to Fiji Airways, only Emirates, Etihad, Swiss Airlines and Qatar Airways are actively promoting a dine on demand option on board.

item.title: ‘We Are All Strangers’ Review: A Micro-Macro Lens Reveals Beauty and Poetry in the Everyday Lives of a Singaporean Family
item.description: A rudderless young man and his hardworking father each experience love, marriage, loss and the fragility of dreams in this concluding part of Anthony Chen’s loosely linked ‘Growing Up’ trilogy.

item.title: ‘Sinners’ Star Wunmi Mosaku Says It Feels “Dystopian” to Celebrate Oscar Nomination After Recent ICE Killings
item.description: "It’s difficult to hold both the nomination and the news because one feels beautiful and one is so dark and heavy," the first-time nominee says.
